MAC_ledger.interpretation: Equal main MAC does not imply equal QDQ, launches, H2D transfer, weight storage, correction or latency. D0 removes pair corrections equally but keeps the other158; all costs must be reported.

measurements.loss: FP64 sum of squared complete native step3 flow error against the same frozen DQ target; identical shape for each source
measurements.primary_matrix: Every source x every N0/NA/NB action, plus original UB1 loss; publish all entries and signed gain terms
measurements.best_fixed: Minimum pooled loss among the exact same three zero-correction actions
measurements.oracle: Sum over sources of the minimum complete native action loss; offline, nondeployable
measurements.noise_eta: Maximum per-source absolute repeated-N0 loss difference divided by that source's original UB1 loss
measurements.on_failure: Close exactly this three-action raw/no-correction D0 probe. Do not tune supports, widths, pair, sources, correction capacity or thresholds after observing its losses. It does not close the unmatched/unrun corrected family or all spatial actions.
measurements.on_pass: No automatic predictor, rollout or spatial routing. A separately registered, correction-matched E1/E2 protocol is still needed.
measurements.promotion_gate: All numeric/cost controls pass AND oracle loss <=0.99*best_fixed loss AND oracle loss <=0.99*frozen_UB1 loss AND relative headroom exceeds10*eta. These are registered diagnostic criteria frozen before new action outcomes, not final quality thresholds.

matched_correction_family_D1.requirement: For all three allocations use the same two-position R256 capacity, original numerical operator and identical fitting budget; freeze arm-specific fits before development action values. A complete216 arm's local target may have zero residual, but do not silently remove its charged correction operator.
matched_correction_family_D1.missing_dependency: Block31 training operands on each arm's actual block30-altered state. Old OP2 block31 sampled rows are not these inputs. A source-frozen streamed collection/fitting protocol and its full model/storage cost remain to be reviewed.
